faq.q: Does the NPWS Visitor Area layer say if a camp is open?
faq.a: No. The camping-area points have a name, a location, an asset id, and coded type and style. They do not include open or closed status, fees or facilities. Those are left blank. NPWS alerts are not loaded on this preview.
